Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
fix: security, performance, and accessibility improvements

Security:
- Add role-based authorization to media, settings, and PPDB actions
- Restrict image remote patterns to specific allowed domains
- Add security headers \(X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, etc.\)

Performance:
- Fix N+1 queries using $transaction for batch operations
- Add updateTag\(\) calls for proper cache invalidation
- Defer Google Analytics loading with requestIdleCallback
- Fix transition: all anti-pattern in CSS

Accessibility:
- Add aria-labels to icon buttons
- Add sr-only text for screen readers
- Add autocomplete, inputMode, spellCheck to form inputs

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")

Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
fix: add safety check for undefined session.user.role

Fixes 500 error on /admin/media by adding optional chaining
to check session?.user?.role before calling canAccess\(\).
This prevents runtime errors when session or role is undefined.

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")
